title: Alaipayuthey
desc: After eloping and getting married to each other by going against their families, a couple realises that living in a marriage is not as simple as it seems.

title: '96
desc: K Ramachandran reunites with his childhood love after many years apart. Consequently, they navigate their shared past and unresolved feelings during a bittersweet meeting.

title: Ponniyin Selvan: I
desc: On the orders of crown prince and his friend Aditha Karikalan, Vallavaraiyan Vandiyadevan embarks on a mission to deliver a message where he discovers several conspiracies against the throne.

title: Saguni
desc: Kamal fights corruption to save his family's legacy, challenging politicians and bureaucrats for justice and redemption.

title: Darbar
desc: Aaditya, a high-ranking law enforcement official, sets out to eradicate the city's gangsters. As the events unfold, it becomes clear that his motivations are deeply personal.
